subject: PHYSICS
genericity_statement: These are generic Physics representation mechanisms for two-dimensional states, vectors, paths, events and observers. They are not projectile-specific and carry no topic-owned numerical quantities.
quantitative_grounding_rule: Default realization is SCHEMATIC_STRUCTURE_ONLY. Any numerical render parameter used in production must be source-bound upstream; the primitive renderer does not invent numerical values.

primitives.instructional_job: Build one two-dimensional coordinate frame with perpendicular axes and one shared origin.
primitives.learner_action: Choose the origin and positive x and y directions before assigning components.
primitives.attention_target: One origin, two perpendicular axes, one physical plane.

primitives.instructional_job: Show one directed vector and its two perpendicular component projections without implying separate objects.
primitives.learner_action: Trace the resultant, then read its x and y component projections against the same axes.
primitives.attention_target: Resultant vector versus its perpendicular components.

primitives.instructional_job: Show successive two-dimensional states of one body on one shared clock, with directed state quantities preserved at each named instant.
primitives.learner_action: Read each state at the same clock instant and compare which vector components changed or stayed fixed.
primitives.attention_target: One object, ordered instants, shared time, evolving vector state.

primitives.instructional_job: Label meaningful events along one two-dimensional path and connect a directed launch/state vector to that path.
primitives.learner_action: Locate the named events first, then attach the relevant vector state to the correct event.
primitives.attention_target: Start, event, end and the state vector attached to one path.

primitives.instructional_job: Compare two two-dimensional paths or states while keeping a named boundary event common between them.
primitives.learner_action: Identify the shared event first, then compare only the path or parameter feature that differs.
primitives.attention_target: Common start/end event versus differing path shape or parameter.

primitives.instructional_job: Show how two coordinate relations sharing one parameter are transformed into a direct relation between the coordinates.
primitives.learner_action: Find the shared parameter, isolate it in one relation, substitute it into the other, then read the resulting path relation.
primitives.attention_target: The same parameter in both coordinate relations and its elimination.

primitives.instructional_job: Show an observer, a target, the horizontal reference and the line-of-sight angle in one plane.
primitives.learner_action: Anchor the observer, draw the sight line, then identify the horizontal and vertical legs that determine the observed angle.
primitives.attention_target: Observer location, sight line and angle-defining right-triangle geometry.
